core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers espresso machines with sleek, modern designs, especially in stainless steel finishes. He seeks a café-like experience without being overly complex—ideal for non-professional users who value both performance and aesthetics.
core_memory.michael_order_details_and_expectations: Order placed with 11-business-day estimated delivery. Regular shipping chosen. Free shipping qualified by adding frothing pitcher and extra filters. All items were in stock at checkout. No back-order or supply shortage expected. Concern about delivery delay and missing accessories.
core_memory.michael_replacement_preference: Michael prefers a hassle-free replacement process. Has taken multiple photos of the damaged box, dents, and bent steam wand. Offers to provide a video if needed. Values simplicity and speed, citing past negative experiences. Ready to share evidence promptly and efficiently.
core_memory.michael_warranty_and_return_policy_query: Michael asks if shipping damage is covered by warranty or return policy. Damage pre-use, not a defect. Believes it should be no-hassle return. Seeks clear policy guidance.
core_memory.michael_support_experience_and_perks: Michael values latte art to impress clients as a freelance designer perk. Offers more photos or safe packaging for return. Asks about prepaid labels and damage prevention.
core_memory.michael_final_positive_note: Michael ends on a positive note, hoping for a quick resolution. Excited to receive a safe, functional machine and froth like a pro. Looks forward to a smooth, customer-focused outcome. Offers to provide order number or details immediately. Expresses gratitude and optimism.
